name: Jam Room
hook: Grab an instrument. Make a beat together.
how: One loop plays for everyone at the same time. You play one of four instruments (drums, bass, chords or lead): tap squares to add notes and hear them land on the next beat. Cheer the parts you like; every song gets a fresh key and tempo.
controls: Click or tap squares to add or remove notes (drag to paint a run); tap another instrument to switch, ♥ to cheer
uses: One player's browser keeps the band's patterns and seats and applies every note; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone hears the same loop on a shared clock and sees every note as it's added.
Bots play the instruments nobody has taken, changing their parts a little every few seconds.
The most cheers each player got in one song.
Set the tempo or the song length for every room without touching code.
ideas: Add a fifth instrument: a cowbell row
Let players pick the scale before a song
